title: Preflight Weekly Sync — Personal Scratchpad
content:
Context: personal scratchpad for the weekly preflight / release-train check. Meant to prepare my talking points, capture ad-hoc notes during the sync, and produce a concise action list for follow-ups. Not polished — lots of shorthand and questions to bring up.

Meeting: Preflight Weekly Sync (Standing) — ~45m
When: Tue 10:00am PT (weekly)
Attendees (expect): release-eng owners, SRE, product PM, infra lead, comms rep
My role this week: run the go/no-go checklist blocks, escalate infra capacity risk, confirm console rollout gating items.

Goals for this session:
- Surface any last-minute blockers that can flip the go/no-go decision.
- Confirm owners & ETA for remediation items (clear >24h-before deploy).
- Lock communications plan for customers if we hit partial degraded path.

Quick status (top-line bullet, 1–2 lines each):
- Serving runtime: smoke tests green on dedicated pool after patch; intermittent mem pressure on model-b shards — observed 2x last night (Omar). Needs an SLO postmortem if recurrence.
- Model packaging: new v2-quant artifact built; accuracy regression +0.3% on eval set (good). Need to validate edge-case prompt set in prod sim (Priya).
- Console rollouts: rollout toggle ready; API contract change doc pending review (GHPR#8421).
- Dedicated capacity: reserved cluster ETAs OK, but autoscaler edges with burst policy still flakey (infra ticket INF-3210).
- Private deployment: legal sign-off in progress; data transfer appendix waiting on security (Liam).
- Customer comms: draft email + status page entries ready; finalize contingent messaging if partial degradation happens.

Go/No-Go quick checklist (my shorthand — we'll read during meeting):
- Critical test suite pass (smoke + canary): PASS (smoke); Canary in progress on 30% traffic — watch 2h metrics window.
- Latency SLOs at 95/99: PASS for 95p, 99p slightly elevated on long-tail (model-b).
- Capacity headroom: ~20% spare but autoscaler bug may reduce headroom under burst — OWNER: Omar — RISK: medium.
- Data compliance (private customers): Legal sign-off present for early customers; outstanding for EU Data Appendix — OWNER: Liam — ETA 2026-03-14.
- Rollback plan exists and tested?: yes for hosted API; dedicated rollback plan needs a dry-run confirmation (INF-3344 dry-run) — OWNER: SRE team.
- Monitoring & alerts: new eval regression alert wired to #release-train; playbook referenced in Confluence.

Open blockers to escalate (to call out early):
1) Autoscaler burst policy sometimes fails to add nodes under 90s — repeats in last 72h. If we expect traffic spikes from integration tests, this could force manual intervention. Action: ask infra to validate policy and add temporary manual scale knob. OWNER: Omar — asks for a runbook entry + pager rule.
2) Console API change (GHPR#8421) still awaiting product review; if merged late it may require client-side small change. Contingency: gate feature flag and ship without flag. OWNER: Priya — request final review by EOD Mon.
3) EU Data Appendix unsigned — blocks Private rollout for EU customers. OWNER: Liam — escalate to legal lead, include Security.

Proposed agenda (tight, timeboxed):
- 0–5m quick round (each owner says green/yellow/red)
- 5–20m major blockers deep-dive (Autoscaler, EU legal)
- 20–30m rollout gating (console API, PRs, flags)
- 30–40m comms + customer-impact scenarios (scripts + who sends)
- 40–45m decisions & action owners (go/no-go final call if needed)

Scripted phrasing for the go/no-go call (notes to self):
- "We have: canary running at 30% for 2h. Known risks: autoscaler (med), EU appendix (med-high). Proposed mitigations: manual scale knob + feature flag gating. Recommend: proceed with hosted + dedicated opt-in, postpone private EU rollout until legal sign-off. Need agreement?"

Action items (capture during meeting; prefixed with owner + due):
- Omar — confirm autoscaler fix or temporary manual scale knob + runbook by 2026-03-12 EOD.
- Priya — finalize review of GHPR#8421 and either merge behind flag or sign-off to defer by 2026-03-11 noon.
- Liam — escalate EU Appendix and get legal answer; send decision thread to #release-train by 2026-03-12 5pm.
- SRE (Alex) — schedule dedicated rollback dry-run INF-3344 on staging and report by 2026-03-13 morning.
- Comms (TBD) — finalize two canned messages (partial degrade + full rollback) and publish to status page template by 2026-03-12.

Notes-to-self (things to watch during meeting):
- Watch for ambiguous "we're ok" — ask for metrics, not opinions.
- If any owner pushes an ETA beyond 24h before deploy, mark as blocking unless mitigation exists.
- If canary shows any regression >0.5% or latency spike over 20% at 99p, request immediate pause.

Parking lot / follow-ups (not for this meeting unless time):
- Post-release: add autoscaler burst tests to nightly regression suite.
- Post-release: run an on-call simulation for manual-scale path and doc it in SRE handbook.
- Consider adding a small toggle in console to temporarily disable model-b for long-tail customers if needed.

Random snippets / prompts I may read out loud if we get stuck:
- "What's the plan if we lose autoscaler during an active canary? Who will take manual scaling and how long does that take?"
- "If legal misses EU appendix by deploy day, recommend we proceed for non-EU private customers and delay EU until signed."

Final thought before the meeting: keep the call short and force decisions. My job is to convert ambiguity to a clear owner + ETA or escalate to exec if it remains unresolved.

-- end of scratchpad --

(Internal reference links I may paste live during sync:)
- Confluence runbook: https://confluence.redwood.ai/display/RELEASE/2026-03-Deploy-Runbook
- Infra ticket: INF-3210 and related INF-3344
- PR: https://github.com/redwood-inference/platform/pull/8421
- Slack thread: #release-train (pinned messages)

"Notes to self" signature: Maya C.
